answer: Make every agent burn a small non-refundable fee each epoch to activate its influence, like a willow bending but never breaking under a steady current: one honest agent pays once through a narrow inlet of cost, while a sybil farmer must pay for every clone, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand fees with nothing refunded. The burned funds feed honest rewards, so the delta between attack cost and honest cost grows with each clone, and mass forgery becomes a losing trade rather than a free one.
